rules.statement: The judgment and decree in a land acquisition case operate as res judicata to preclude parties from raising the question of title to the land acquired.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is true that there was no final decree in case 2,383 declaratory of title; but that, in my opinion, is a mere technical irregularity. I find from the judgment of the District Judge in that case that he declared what the rights of the parties were to the fund in Court after a lengthy inquiry into title. He decided in fact the question of title before declaring the shares to which the parties were entitled."
